Unified context menus across the prototype builder.

### Core
- **`menus.ts`** — `MenuTarget` / `MenuActionId`, `buildMenuItems()` per surface, z-order helpers (`nudgeZOrder`, `applyZOrder`), shortcut templates
- **`menus.test.ts`** — menu model and z-order tests
- **`INTERACTIONS.md`** — shared click/selection/drag/context-menu rules
- **`components/ui/anchored-menu.tsx`** — keyboard-navigable menu, viewport clamping
- **`prototype-context-menu.tsx`** — i18n + menu model → anchored menu

### Wiring
- **`builder.tsx`** — single menu host, action dispatch (including front/back, pages, inserts, F2 rename)
- **`left-pane.tsx`** — outline/pages/palette/template/icon menus; shift/cmd outline selection
- **`canvas.tsx`** — page tab context menu
- **`shell.tsx`** — block native context menu outside text fields
- **`icons-library.tsx`**, **`template-tile.tsx`** — tile context menus
- **`i18n.ts`** — new menu strings (EN/RU)

**Changed paths:**  
`src/studio/prototype/menus.ts`, `menus.test.ts`, `INTERACTIONS.md`, `prototype-context-menu.tsx`, `canvas-context-menu.tsx`, `builder.tsx`, `left-pane.tsx`, `canvas.tsx`, `shell.tsx`, `icons-library.tsx`, `template-tile.tsx`, `components/ui/anchored-menu.tsx`, `src/shared/i18n.ts`

`npx tsc --noEmit` and 112 prototype tests pass.
